channel.title: Proxly Updates
channel.description: Updates for Proxly - Smart Browser Chooser

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
• **iCloud Sync (Beta)**: Synchronize rules and settings across all your devices using iCloud
  • **Rule Import & Export**: Backup and share your routing rules
  • **Browser Visibility Management**: Control which browsers appear in selection menus
  • **Delete All Rules**: Quick way to remove all routing rules at once
  • **Settings Interface**: Redesigned settings with improved organization and visual design
  • **Onboarding Experience**: Enhanced first-time experience with setting up the iCloud sync
  • **Notification System**: Unified notification service for better user awareness
  • **Notifications**: The notifications will correctly "pop up" now, as expected
